name: lemonvite-invitations
title_zh: 聊天里说清聚会，它就出邀请函和 RSVP 页
tagline_zh: 不用再开设计软件或手抄名单。派对、宝宝宴、 reunion 都能从对话直接变邀请函草稿，发出去后谁点了参加。
tagline_en: Skip design tools and spreadsheets. Turn any gathering chat into a polished invitation, publish it, and see who's.
desc_en: Create, design and send digital event invitations with RSVP tracking through Lemonvite: turn an event described in chat into an invitation draft, manage the guest list, publish to deliver the invitations, and read who has responded. Use when the user wants a real invitation, RSVP page or guest list for a party, celebration, shower, reunion or any gathering, or mentions Lemonvite.
why_zh: 它把「邀请」当成一条完整链路：从对话提炼信息成草稿，到管理宾客名单、发布、回收 RSVP。
why_en: Treats invitations as a full workflow—draft from chat, manage guests, publish, and track responses—not just a one-off image.
limit_zh: 只认 Lemonvite 生态，产物是 Lemonvite 的邀请函与 RSVP 页，不导出 PDF 或邮件。
limit_en: Lemonvite-only output (no PDF/email); requires network to publish—offline stops at draft stage.
title_en: Turn chat into invitations with RSVP tracking
